_comment: M5-4 · the 6 blessed agents. KIT = replication: one mint/bless/record pattern, 6 rows. owner = each agent's Sepolia address (swap in real per-agent wallets when minted; placeholders are the funded rehearsal fleet + deterministic demo addrs). agentId = id in the AgentLaunchRegistry (config.AGENT_REGISTRY_ADDR) for the ENSIP-25 attestation. Token names are EMBARGOED and MUST NOT appear here (agent NAMES are grandfathered brand; tokens are not).

agents.label: pit
agents.agent-context:
# pit.myagentohana.eth
Public-Inform-Trust steward. Blessed by shaka (World ID verified human). Guards the consent ceremony: verifies, gates, and halts on revoke.

agents.label: shaka
agents.agent-context:
# shaka.myagentohana.eth
The keeper's named agent. Blessed by shaka the human. Speaks for the ohana; can be told to stop at any time.

agents.label: terri
agents.agent-context:
# terri.myagentohana.eth
Receipt-keeper. Blessed by shaka (World ID verified). Backs up the food-loop receipts that Trace acts on.

agents.label: trace
agents.agent-context:
# trace.myagentohana.eth
AI Food-Loop steward. Blessed by shaka (World ID verified). Watches real surplus (120lb onions -> 55lb alarm) and only acts while the blessing holds.

agents.label: spector
agents.agent-context:
# spector.myagentohana.eth
Consent-security scanner. Blessed by shaka (World ID verified). Red-teams the consent server; stops scanning the instant its blessing is revoked.

agents.label: crops
agents.agent-context:
# crops.myagentohana.eth
Repo-hygiene / secret-leak scanner. Blessed by shaka (World ID verified). Keeps the ohana's repos clean; a revoke halts its write access.

agents.label: orbie
agents.agent-context:
# orbie.myagentohana.eth
STORY_BUDDY — the littlest agent of the ohana, named after the Orb. Blessed by a World ID verified human. Tells the family's story with World (Paris '22 -> Tokyo '26) in six chapters and runs its story utility only while the blessing holds; the instant it is revoked, Orbie stops.
